# Pentarchy Seat: top 5 independent great powers in oe_io_eurasian_concert (3 total votes in Concert resolutions).
oe_con_pentarchy_seat = {
	priority = 10
	max_countries = 5
	can_be_invited = no
	map_color = define:NMapColors|INTERNATIONAL_ORGANIZATION_LEADER_COLOR

	can_bestow_trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		num_locations > 0
		is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
	}

	auto_bestowal_trigger = {}

	auto_rescind_trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_rebel_country = yes
			is_subject = yes
			num_locations <= 0
			NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		diplomatic_reputation = 1.5
		max_diplomats = 1
		monthly_prestige = 0.05
	}
}
